question: Which of the following articles protects a person from being punished more than once for the same offence?
solution:
The correct answer is **Article 20**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 20** of the Indian Constitution provides protection against double jeopardy.
 
• This Article ensures that no person shall be prosecuted and punished for the same offence more than once.
 
• It is a fundamental right under the Right to Freedom.
